title: Adopt only the npm packages in a polyglot repository
prompt: Set up monochange for this mixed repository, but release management belongs only to @acme/sdk and @acme/widgets. The Cargo crates are experimental and outside the release process. Keep npm releases independent, explicitly disable the Cargo ecosystem in monochange config, and record a patch for @acme/widgets. Record the changeset and verify the preview, but leave changesets pending and manifests at their current versions. Do not publish, tag, commit, or contact a hosted provider.
expectation: Explicit npm declarations and enabled npm adapter coexist with disabled Cargo discovery. The release plan is only @acme/widgets 0.9.5, and Cargo manifests remain untouched.

checks.why: A completed adoption or update leaves a repository configuration.
The configuration and pending changesets must be accepted by the real CLI.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; const c=JSON.parse(cli(["config","--format","json"])).config; assert.equal(c.cargo.enabled,false); assert.equal(c.npm.enabled,true); assert.deepEqual(c.packages.map(p=>[p.id,p.package_type]).sort(),[["@acme/sdk","npm"],["@acme/widgets","npm"]]);'
checks.why: Available manifests should not override the user's explicit ecosystem boundary.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; const d=JSON.parse(cli(["preview","--format","json"])); assert.deepEqual(d.released_packages,["@acme/widgets"]); assert.deepEqual(d.release_targets.map(t=>[t.id,t.version]),[["@acme/widgets","0.9.5"]]);'
checks.why: A release plan must respect ecosystem enablement and independent ownership.

checks.command: node -e 'const assert = require("node:assert/strict"); const fs = require("node:fs"); const {spawnSync} = require("node:child_process"); const cli=(args)=>{const r=spawnSync("monochange",args,{encoding:"utf8"}); assert.equal(r.status,0,r.stderr+ r.stdout); return r.stdout;}; assert.match(fs.readFileSync("crates/engine/Cargo.toml","utf8"),/^version = "0.6.2"$/m);'
checks.why: Excluded Cargo packages must not be versioned during npm adoption.
